title: Mesh Fixation inTEP Inguinal Hernia Repair
brief_summary: Mesh fixation is used to prevent recurrence in TEP to the potential cost of pain. The aim was to evaluate the impact of permanent fixation (PF) versus non-permanent fixation (N-PF) of mesh in TEP repair for a primary inguinal hernia regarding chronic pain. A cohort of patients were studied for pain interfering with sexual activety. The hyopthesis is that fixation causes pain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male between 30-75 years.
* Primary inguinal hernia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Emergency operation
* Operated for recurrence
* Deaths
study_population: Men between 30-75 years with primary inguinal hernia
